items.title: Accessible Meetings Checklist
items.summary: A practical checklist for planning virtual, in-person, and hybrid meetings that people can actually access.
items.body: Use a visible accommodation request process, share materials in advance, provide captioning or interpretation when needed, structure the agenda clearly, build in breaks, and send follow-up materials in accessible formats.

items.title: Cultural Humility Core Practices
items.summary: A staff-facing framework for self-reflection, power awareness, and culturally responsive practice.
items.body: Treat cultural knowledge as a way to ask better questions, not as a shortcut to certainty. Examine assumptions, invite correction, share decision-making power, and keep accountability visible in the work.

items.title: Inclusive Language Basics
items.summary: A short learning module for language choices that support dignity, clarity, and participation.
items.body: Use plain language, respect how people name themselves, avoid labels that reduce a person to a condition or role, and revise language when someone tells you it does not fit.

items.title: Supported Decision-Making Walk-Through
items.summary: A rights-based guide for helping people make their own decisions with support from trusted people.
items.body: Start from the person's decision-making authority. Use supporters to make information clearer, slow down complex choices, strengthen communication, and preserve the person's right to direct their own life.

items.title: Person-Centered Practice and Self-Determination
items.summary: A practical orientation to starting with what matters to the person and supporting real choice.
items.body: Listen first, offer real options in plain language, support without taking over, and presume competence. The person is the expert on their own life; staff expertise helps make the path workable.
